description_en: Sales invoice line detail storing invoiced products quantities prices taxes and net invoice line amounts.

Do not join M_INOUTLINE unless the question is explicitly about delivery; M_INOUTLINE does not contain C_INVOICELINE_ID. Current Docker PostgreSQL import covers the 2025-01-01 to 2026-07-01 export window: whole 2025 plus 2026 so far.

description_en: Business partner master data containing customers suppliers partner codes names groups and commercial flags.

description_en: Document type reference table describing sales orders customer invoices credit memos depots counters markets and document base types.

description_en: Monthly sales forecasting fact table with invoiced CA ordered CA invoice counts order counts paid and unpaid invoice amounts and partial-month flag.
description_fr: Table de faits mensuelle pour prevision des ventes avec CA facture CA commande nombres de factures commandes montants payes impayes et indicateur mois partiel.
key_columns: MONTH:date:First day of month primary key|CA_FACTURE:numeric:Invoiced sales CA from invoice GRANDTOTAL TTC|N_FACTURES:int:Number of invoices|CA_COMMANDE:numeric:Ordered sales CA from order GRANDTOTAL TTC|N_COMMANDES:int:Number of orders|CA_FACTURE_PAYE:numeric:Paid invoiced CA|CA_FACTURE_IMPAYE:numeric:Unpaid invoiced CA|IS_PARTIAL:boolean:True for current incomplete month
notes: Use for trend forecasting ML Prophet training seasonal sales monthly CA and 24-month history questions. Exclude IS_PARTIAL true rows from model training.

description_en: Monthly invoiced CA by commercial or sales representative for forecasting and commercial trend drill-down.
description_fr: CA facture mensuel par commercial pour prevision et analyse des tendances commerciales.
key_columns: MONTH:date:First day of month|SALESREP_ID:bigint:Sales representative identifier|COMMERCIAL_NAME:text:Commercial display name|CA_FACTURE:numeric:Invoiced CA GRANDTOTAL TTC|N_FACTURES:int:Number of invoices|IS_PARTIAL:boolean:Current incomplete month flag
notes: Use for monthly commercial performance and forecast drill-down by salesrep. Exclude IS_PARTIAL true rows from ML training.

description_en: Monthly invoiced line CA by product category for category-level seasonality and forecasting analysis.
description_fr: CA facture mensuel HT par categorie produit pour saisonnalite et prevision par categorie.
key_columns: MONTH:date:First day of month|CATEGORY_ID:bigint:Product category identifier|CATEGORY_NAME:text:Product category label|CA_FACTURE:numeric:Invoice line net amount HT|IS_PARTIAL:boolean:Current incomplete month flag
notes: Use for monthly category trends and seasonality. CA here is invoice-line LINENETAMT HT, not header GRANDTOTAL TTC.

description_en: Monthly invoiced line CA by product theme for theme-level seasonality and forecasting analysis.
description_fr: CA facture mensuel HT par thematique produit pour saisonnalite et prevision par theme.
key_columns: MONTH:date:First day of month|THEME_ID:bigint:Product theme identifier|THEME_NAME:text:Product theme label|CA_FACTURE:numeric:Invoice line net amount HT|IS_PARTIAL:boolean:Current incomplete month flag
notes: Use for monthly thematique trends and seasonality. CA here is invoice-line LINENETAMT HT and rows without theme are excluded.

description_en: Corrected customer portfolio for the 2025+2026 export with customer attributes order counts invoice counts ordered CA invoiced CA paid CA and unpaid CA.
description_fr: Portefeuille client corrige pour export 2025+2026 avec attributs client nombres commandes factures CA commande CA facture CA paye et impaye.
key_columns: C_BPARTNER_ID:bigint:Customer identifier|CUSTOMER_CODE:text:Customer code|CUSTOMER_NAME:text:Customer name|ORDER_COUNT:int:Number of orders|ORDERED_CA_TTC:numeric:Ordered CA TTC aggregated separately|INVOICE_COUNT:int:Number of invoices|INVOICED_CA_TTC:numeric:Invoiced CA TTC aggregated separately|PAID_CA_TTC:numeric:Paid invoiced CA|UNPAID_CA_TTC:numeric:Unpaid invoiced CA
notes: Use for customer portfolio ranking and credit/open-balance context. This corrected table avoids the many-to-many CA inflation issue in the older file 57.

description_en: Business partner location bridge connecting customers or partners to physical location records.
description_fr: Table de liaison entre tiers clients partenaires et adresses physiques.
key_columns: C_BPARTNER_LOCATION_ID:bigint:Partner location identifier|C_BPARTNER_ID:bigint:Business partner|C_LOCATION_ID:bigint:Physical location|NAME:text:Location name|ISACTIVE:char(1):Active flag
notes: Use only for customer address city or region analysis, normally together with C_LOCATION C_CITY and C_REGION.

description_en: Physical address/location table with city region country and address fields for customer geography analysis.
description_fr: Table des adresses physiques avec ville region pays et champs adresse pour analyse geographique client.
key_columns: C_LOCATION_ID:bigint:Physical location identifier|ADDRESS1:text:Address line|CITY:text:City text|C_CITY_ID:bigint:City identifier|C_REGION_ID:bigint:Region identifier|C_COUNTRY_ID:bigint:Country identifier
notes: Use for customer geography, city and region questions. Be careful with address fields because they may contain customer-specific locations.

description_en: Payment term reference table used to label customer and invoice payment conditions.
description_fr: Referentiel des conditions de paiement utilise pour libeller les modalites client et facture.
key_columns: C_PAYMENTTERM_ID:bigint:Payment term identifier|NAME:text:Payment term label|NETDAYS:bigint:Net payment days|ISDUEFIXED:char(1):Fixed due date flag
notes: Use for questions about payment terms such as 120 J and customer payment conditions.

description_en: Price list reference table used to label customer and order pricing lists.
description_fr: Referentiel des listes de prix utilise pour libeller les tarifs client et commande.
key_columns: M_PRICELIST_ID:bigint:Price list identifier|NAME:text:Price list label|DESCRIPTION:text:Description|C_CURRENCY_ID:bigint:Currency
notes: Use for customer pricing list segmentation and portfolio context.

description_en: Region reference table for geographic grouping of customer locations.
description_fr: Referentiel des regions pour regroupement geographique des adresses client.
key_columns: C_REGION_ID:bigint:Region identifier|NAME:text:Region name|C_COUNTRY_ID:bigint:Country identifier
notes: Use with C_LOCATION and C_BPARTNER_LOCATION for regional customer and CA analysis.

description_en: City reference table for geographic grouping of customer locations.
description_fr: Referentiel des villes pour regroupement geographique des adresses client.
key_columns: C_CITY_ID:bigint:City identifier|NAME:text:City name|C_REGION_ID:bigint:Region identifier|C_COUNTRY_ID:bigint:Country identifier
notes: Use with C_LOCATION and C_BPARTNER_LOCATION for city-level customer and CA analysis.
